tasks.name: GenerateAndTest
tasks.description: Generates potential solutions to a problem and tests them for their effectiveness in addressing the problem
tasks.given: Initial state and goal state are defined; problem constraints are specified; generator and tester components are available
tasks.makes: A valid path from initial state to goal state is found that satisfies all constraints, or failure is reported if no solution exists

tasks.name: SolveGuardsAndPrisonersProblem
tasks.description: Find a valid sequence of boat trips to transport all guards and prisoners across the river without ever having more prisoners than guards on either bank
tasks.given: Initial state has all guards and prisoners on left bank; boat capacity is 2; prisoners cannot outnumber guards on either bank
tasks.makes: All guards and prisoners are on right bank; no constraints violated during solution

tasks.name: SolveRavensProgressiveMatrices
tasks.description: Determine the missing figure in a Raven's Progressive Matrix by identifying and applying transformations
tasks.given: Semantic network representation of figures; transformation patterns exist between A→B
tasks.makes: Selected answer matches transformation pattern with highest confidence
